column1: # ACCESS platform: twelve provider strategies, four mobile SDKs, webhooks,
# multi-account sync. Its `SeriesType` enum is 93 stable integer ids with a
# name and a free-text unit label, and deliberately no terminology system —
# its own standardization document says so. This file is the seam: run
# open-wearables to CONNECT devices, run mirobody to make the data mean one
# thing and answer questions about it.
#   ow_unit      the unit label it publishes, verbatim
#   metric       the mirobody catalogue name, or empty when we have none
#   note         why, when the mapping is not an identity
# A row with an empty `metric` is an EXPLICIT decline, not an omission: the
# decoder quarantines that type rather than guessing a name, and the note says
# what a consumer would have to add to the catalogue to accept it. That is the
# same rule `metrics.mapping_for` follows — a confident wrong code is worse
